title: Enterprise Connectivity: invoice maturity period
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following invoice maturity period for each named contract tier. Calendar days after invoice issue for payment maturity; integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | invoice maturity period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | invoice maturity period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | invoice maturity period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | invoice maturity period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | invoice maturity period | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | invoice maturity period | 30 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the invoice maturity period is 30.
